effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you would play a green Tamer from your hand, by suspending 1 of your green Digimon, reduce the play cost by 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, if you have a green Tamer, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
